notes: §1985:X.4.4.2 is 'RD report-name-1 [IS GLOBAL] [CODE literal-1] [CONTROL ...] [PAGE [LIMIT IS|LIMITS ARE] integer-1 [LINE|LINES] [HEADING integer-2] [FIRST DETAIL integer-3] [LAST DETAIL integer-4] [FOOTING integer-5]]' (§1985:X.4.4.4 GR2 sends the non-GLOBAL clauses to Report Writer, §1985:XIII.3.8.2; order free, §1985:XIII.3.5.3 SR2). The grammar is the 2023 format (CobolReportWriter.g4#reportDescriptionEntry/reportPageClause) and ReportSectionBinder.BindReportDescriptionClauses binds it; at 85 the GLOBAL, CONTROL and integer-1 parts, a repeated clause (COBOL2423), CODE identifier-1 and a non-2-char literal (COBOL2713 in BindCodeClause) and a 4-digit page limit (COBOL2744) are refused, and the witness (IS GLOBAL RD used from two contained programs) runs. But no edition arm refuses the 2002/2023 additions to the PAGE clause: probes at --std 85 of 'PAGE LIMIT IS 20 LINES 80 COLUMNS', 'PAGE 80 COLUMNS' (no integer-1, which the 1985 format requires), 'LAST CONTROL HEADING 10', 'LAST CH 10', 'FIRST DE 3', 'HEADING IS 1', 'PAGE IS 20 LINES' and 'CODE IS "AB"' each compile and run (RUN OK, exit 0). Already filed as kb/Work PB5242 (open), which names COLUMNS, LAST CONTROL HEADING, IS, DE/CH and CODE IS; the integer-1-omitted shape and 'PAGE IS' are the same mechanism. Probe classes: b (refusals: clause twice, CODE 3-char/numeric/identifier, page limit 1000) and c (the 2002/2023 PAGE and CODE additions); a, d, e, f do not reach a format rule of the RD entry. kb/Work PB5242 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-02.json).

next.reason: 1985 IPC RD: 'RD report-name-1 [IS GLOBAL] [CODE literal-1] [CONTROL ...] [PAGE LIMIT integer-1 LINES [HEADING] [FIRST DETAIL] [LAST DETAIL] [FOOTING]]', integer-1 required. §2023:13.14.2 keeps RD with [IS GLOBAL] (§2023:13.18.27.2) and the CONTROL clause unchanged (§2023:13.18.16.2), but CODE also takes identifier-1 (§2023:13.18.12.2) and the PAGE clause (§2023:13.18.39.2) adds a page width 'integer-2 COLUMNS', LAST CONTROL HEADING and the DE/CH abbreviations (§2023:13.18.39.3 SR1), and lets integer-1 be omitted ('Either integer-1 or integer-2 or both shall be specified', §2023:13.18.39.3 SR2). More RDs accepted. CHANGED (looser).
